title: If any foreign-going ship 173(1) The owner shall be liable
text:
51. If any foreign-going ship 173(1) The owner shall be liable

referred to in sub-section (1) of for each voyage of the ship
section 173 does not carry on made without having on
board a duly qualified board a duty qualified

medical officer. medical officer, a fine

which may extend to two
hundred rupees.
